tool_input.command:
$B="/tmp/scratch\research"
$l=Get-Content "$B\compound\list.txt"
"hooks:"; $l|?{$_ -match 'hook'}|select -First 15
"agents md count (references/agents):"; ($l|?{$_ -match '^skills/.*/references/agents/.*\.md$'}).Count
"unique agent names:"; ($l|?{$_ -match 'references/agents/.*\.md$'}|%{Split-Path $_ -Leaf}|sort -Unique).Count
"scripts:"; ($l|?{$_ -match '^skills/.*/scripts/'}).Count
"workflows"; $l|?{$_ -match '^\.github/workflows'}
"src files"; ($l|?{$_ -match '^src/'}).Count; "tests"; ($l|?{$_ -match '^tests/'}).Count; "docs"; ($l|?{$_ -match '^docs/'}).Count
$l|?{$_ -match '^(plugins|agents|commands)/'}|select -First 10
function G($p){$f="$B\compound\"+($p -replace '/','__');curl.exe -s "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EveryInc/compound-engineering-plugin/HEAD/$p" -o $f;"$p "+(Get-Item $f).Length}
foreach($p in 'README.md','.claude-plugin/plugin.json','CONCEPTS.md','CLAUDE.md','STRATEGY.md','skills/ce-brainstorm/SKILL.md','skills/ce-plan/SKILL.md','skills/ce-work/SKILL.md','skills/ce-code-review/SKILL.md','skills/ce-compound/SKILL.md','skills/ce-debug/SKILL.md','skills/ce-retro/SKILL.md','skills/lfg/SKILL.md','skills/ce-handoff/SKILL.md','skills/ce-noslop/SKILL.md','skills/wtf/SKILL.md'){G $p}
